predictions.headline: Islanders' goaltending and defence make them a clear home favourite
predictions.text: New York Islanders to win the moneyline against the Los Angeles Kings at UBS Arena. The Islanders are 5-3-1 and have conceded only 19 goals in nine games, a 2.11 goals-against average, while scoring 27. Los Angeles have played just seven games, going 1-4-2, and have shipped 27 goals at 3.86 per game while scoring 17. Bo Horvat leads New York with five goals, Matthew Schaefer has eight assists and Ilya Sorokin has five wins; the Kings' leading scorer is Artemi Panarin with four. The model makes the Islanders a 71.2% favourite, the highest NHL probability on this slate.
